# Security policy

## Supported versions

Starmap accepts vulnerability reports for the default branch and the latest
release. Earlier releases can contain defects that the latest release fixes.

## Report a vulnerability

Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting][report] to report a security
vulnerability. Do not disclose the vulnerability in a public issue or pull
request.

Include this information when it is available:

- The affected version or commit.
- The conditions that reproduce the vulnerability.
- The expected security impact.
- A suggested correction or mitigation.

The maintainers will use the private advisory to discuss the report. The
maintainers will publish an advisory after a correction is available when the
vulnerability affects a released version.

[report]: https://github.com/agentstation/starmap/security/advisories/new
